faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
faq.subtitle: Answers about learning, live classes, payments, certificates and using SiriUpSkill
faq.ctaDesc: Our team is here to assist you during business hours.
faq.pageDescription: Frequently asked questions about learning, live classes, payments, certificates and using SiriUpSkill

about.q: What is SiriUpSkill and who is it for?
about.a: SiriUpSkill is an online course platform. Instructors create and publish their own courses, and learners buy the courses they are interested in to build skills they can use at work. Browse every available category and course on the Courses page.

access.q: How many times can I rewatch a course, and does access expire?
access.a: You can rewatch as often as you like while your access is active. The access period is set per course: some courses never expire and others have a limited period, shown on each course’s detail page before you buy.

certificate.q: How do I get a certificate?
certificate.a: When you finish every lesson in a course (100% progress), the system issues a digital certificate automatically, with a verification code and a QR code that anyone can use to check it on the certificate verification page.

invoice.q: How do I get a receipt or a tax invoice?
invoice.a: After a successful payment you can view and print your receipt from Order History. A full tax invoice is not issued automatically at checkout at the moment. For tax invoice enquiries, contact the team through the Contact page and include your order number.

methods.a: You can pay by scanning a Thai QR PromptPay code from any banking app that supports PromptPay (processed by Stripe). Credit/debit cards (Visa, Mastercard) appear as an option on the checkout page only once they are enabled. Installment payments are not supported at the moment.

devices.q: Can I sign in on several devices at the same time?
devices.a: The number of devices signed in at the same time per account is limited to help prevent account sharing. The default is 2 devices. When you sign in beyond the limit, the system automatically signs out the device that has been signed in the longest and notifies you by email. You can review and remove devices you no longer use on the Signed-in devices page.

liveWhat.q: How are live and Hybrid courses different from regular video courses?
liveWhat.a: A live course runs as sessions on a schedule set by the instructor: you join an online classroom with the instructor at the time of each session. A Hybrid course has both live sessions and videos you can watch whenever you like. The schedule (Thailand time) is shown on the course detail page.

liveJoin.q: How do I join a live class, and why do I need to sign in and buy the course first?
liveJoin.a: The classroom link is not shown publicly. Join with the join button on the course’s Live tab, or through the link in your invitation email. The system checks that you are signed in and have active, unexpired access to that course before taking you into the room, so only enrolled learners can enter. The room opens a little before the session starts and closes when it ends. Please do not forward the classroom link to anyone else.

liveInvites.q: What do I receive after buying a live course?
liveInvites.a: After a successful payment the system emails you a summary of the schedule with a calendar file (.ics) you can add to your calendar, and sends reminder emails before each session (about 24 hours and 1 hour before it starts). If the instructor changes the time or cancels a session, the update or cancellation is also sent to you by email.

liveReplay.q: Can I watch a live session I missed?
liveReplay.a: Yes, once the instructor has uploaded the recording of that session. It then appears as a video lesson in the course (the replay button). Classrooms are not recorded automatically, so you have to wait for the instructor to upload it. If you buy the course after some sessions have already taken place, you can watch the recordings of those sessions as soon as the instructor has uploaded them.

liveAccess.q: How long can I access a live course, and is there an enrollment deadline?
liveAccess.a: The access period is set per course, just like regular courses (see the course detail page). For live and Hybrid courses that have an access period, it is counted from the start of the course’s first live session if that session has not started yet; if it has already started, or the instructor has not set a schedule yet, it is counted from the purchase date. Instructors may also set an enrollment deadline and a seat limit; once enrollment closes or the seats are full, the course can no longer be purchased.

liveRefund.q: Can I get a refund for a live course?
liveRefund.a: You can submit a refund request from Order History and the team reviews it case by case. However, once you have joined a live session of a course, the system will not accept a refund request for that course’s share (other courses in the same order that you have not attended live can still be requested). See the Refund Policy for details.

terms.pageDescription: Terms and conditions for using the SiriUpSkill online course platform
terms.title: Terms of Service

s1.heading: 1. Introduction and general agreement
s1.p1: Welcome to SiriUpSkill, an online course platform. By accessing or using our website and services you confirm that you have read, understood and agreed to be bound by all of these terms and conditions.

s2.heading: 2. Registration and user accounts
s2.b1: You must provide a valid, complete and truthful email address and information when you sign up.
s2.b2: You are responsible for keeping your password and your account access confidential.
s2.b3: Do not share your account. The number of devices signed in at the same time is limited (Concurrent Session Protection), and when the limit is exceeded the system automatically signs out the device that has been signed in the longest.

s3.heading: 3. Intellectual property and content copyright
s3.p1: All content, videos, supporting documents, quizzes and sample code on SiriUpSkill are the intellectual property of the instructors and SiriUpSkill. You must not copy, modify, publish, screen-record or redistribute them to third parties without written permission.
s3.p2: To deter copyright infringement, the system overlays the learner account’s name and email address with a timestamp as a moving watermark on videos, and keeps video playback logs, so the source can be traced if content is leaked without permission.

s4.heading: 4. Payments and refund policy
s4.p1: Payments are processed through the payment provider Stripe, which supports Thai QR PromptPay. Credit/debit cards appear as an option on the checkout page only once they are enabled. Prices and discounts are calculated by the system at the time of order, access starts once the system receives payment confirmation from the provider, and orders that are not paid within the allowed time expire automatically.
s4.p2: The access period is set per course and shown on the course detail page. Refund requests are handled under our

s5.heading: 5. Community rules and prohibited conduct
s5.p1: You must not compromise the security of the system, attempt to hack it, distribute malware, or post rude, disruptive or unlawful messages in the discussion and Q&A areas.

privacy.pageDescription: Personal data protection policy and PDPA rights for SiriUpSkill users
privacy.title: Privacy Policy and Personal Data Protection (PDPA)
privacy.subtitle: Prepared to explain how personal data is processed under the Thai Personal Data Protection Act B.E. 2562 (2019) (PDPA)

s1.heading: 1. Personal data we collect
s1.identityText: display name, email address, password (stored only as a hash), profile picture (if any, for example the picture from your Google account when you sign in with Google)
s1.paymentText: order and payment history, including the name and tax ID you provide when a tax invoice is issued. We do not store credit/debit card numbers; card payments (when enabled) are processed by Stripe.
s1.usageText: sign-in history and signed-in devices (device name, browser and IP address), video playback logs (including IP address), live classroom join logs, and learning progress
s1.contentText: questions and comments in the discussion/Q&A area, submitted assignments and quiz answers
s1.instructorText: instructor profile data (display name and introduction) and payout account data (bank account/PromptPay and tax ID), plus the Google Calendar connection token if the instructor connects it to create live classrooms

s2.heading: 2. Purposes of processing
s2.p1: We process data to provide the online course service (including live session invitations), issue completion certificates, issue receipts and tax documents, pay instructors their revenue share, keep the system secure, and prevent account sharing and video copyright infringement (for example by showing the account’s name and email as a watermark on videos), and to send important course notifications. We keep data only as needed for these purposes and as required by law, for example order records and financial documents.

s3.heading: 3. Data subject rights
s3.intro: You have the following rights under the PDPA:
s3.accessLabel: Right of access, copy and data portability:
s3.accessText: You can export your personal data as a JSON file yourself from
s3.erasureText: You can delete your account yourself from the same page. The system signs you out of every device and anonymizes the account’s personal data; order records and financial documents that the law requires us to keep remain in non-identifying form. Manage it at
s3.objectLabel: Right to object or withdraw consent:
s3.objectText: You can accept or decline non-essential cookies in the banner shown the first time you visit the site. To withdraw consent or object to other processing, contact the Data Protection Officer using the details in section 6.

s4.heading: 4. Service providers involved with your data
s4.p1: We use third-party providers to deliver the service: Stripe (payments), Bunny.net (video storage and delivery), Google (sign-in with Google and live classrooms through Google Meet/Calendar) and an email delivery provider. For live courses where the instructor turns on invitations through Google Calendar, enrolled learners’ email addresses are also sent to Google to invite them.

s5.heading: 5. Data security
s5.p1: Passwords are stored as PBKDF2 hashes and are never stored in plain text. Instructors’ payout account data (bank account number and tax ID) is encrypted with authenticated encryption (AES-256-GCM) before it is stored. We do not store credit/debit card numbers, and connections use HTTPS.

s6.heading: 6. Contacting the Data Protection Officer (DPO)
s6.p1: If you have questions about this policy or want to exercise your PDPA rights, contact the Data Protection Officer at

refund.pageDescription: How refunds work for SiriUpSkill online courses
refund.title: Refund Policy

s1.heading: 1. How refund requests are reviewed
s1.p1: Learners can submit a refund request for any order that has been paid successfully. The team reviews each request case by case, based on the reason given and the order details, and tells you the outcome. Refunds are never approved automatically. Example reasons include a duplicate purchase, content that does not match the description, or a technical problem on the platform’s side.

s2.heading: 2. Live courses
s2.p1: Once you have joined a live classroom of a course at least once, the system will not accept a refund request for that course’s share. Other courses in the same order that you have not attended live can still be refunded. This rule does not affect reasons unrelated to attending live classes, such as a technical problem on the platform’s side.

s3.heading: 3. How to request a refund
s3.p1: Learners can submit a refund request themselves from
s3.p2: by pressing the "Request Refund" button on the order and giving a reason (an order with no amount paid, such as a free course, has nothing to refund).
s3.p3: If you have questions before submitting a request, ask the support team at

s4.heading: 4. Refund channels and timing
s4.general: Once a request is approved, the team processes the refund through the original payment channel. How long it takes for the money to arrive depends on the payment method and your bank.
s4.promptpayText: PromptPay refunds are asynchronous. The payment provider (Stripe) may contact the buyer to ask for the bank account details to refund to. If the required details are not provided, the refund may stay pending until they are.
s4.cardText: The money is returned to the original card. How long it takes depends on the card issuing bank.
